title: Presentation snapshot manifest v2
description: Immutable captured version of one Mass plan, with its Themes, Mass sections, items, Cues and the frame and asset dependencies the Cues show. dependencies_fingerprint is the SHA-256 of every frames[].sha256 and assets[].sha256 sorted, each followed by LF; it covers dependency bytes only, so the structure is pinned separately by the SHA-256 of the exact manifest bytes. Every Project Cue frame_id must name a frame of this snapshot and every frame must be shown by a Project Cue; every item and Cue id is unique. Frame and asset bytes live beside the manifest under frames/ and assets/; their sha256 is checked by the reader. v1 stays frozen and is not read by a v2 reader. All identities (snapshot, Mass plan, Celebration, Themes, sections, items, Cues, frames, assets) share one namespace and must be unique across it; JSON Schema cannot express that, the reader enforces it. The exact manifest bytes are pinned by their SHA-256, since escapes, member order and whitespace vary for equal content.

id.description: Stable UUIDv4 of this snapshot manifest (SnapshotId).

mass_plan_id.description: UUID of the Mass plan this snapshot captures.

celebration_id.description: UUID of the Celebration the Mass plan belongs to.

captured_at.description: UTC time the snapshot was captured.

themes.description: Themes the snapshot lists; each has a unique id.

mass_theme_id.description: The Theme of the whole Mass; names one of themes[].id.

sections.description: Mass sections in order; at least one.

frames.description: Frame files the Project Cues show, each with its SHA-256.

assets.description: Binary assets the frames use, each with exact byte size and SHA-256.

dependencies_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint over every frames[].sha256 and assets[].sha256.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of exact bytes.

text.description: One line of non-blank text that does not end in whitespace. The reader is stricter than this pattern: it rejects any trailing Unicode whitespace (Rust char::is_whitespace, including U+00A0), not only the characters \s matches.

theme_id.description: Theme override for this item; names one of themes[].id. Absent means the Mass Theme.

auto_play_seconds.description: Default auto-play seconds; general_presentation items only. Absent means manual advance.

private_context.description: Operator-only text, never projected. Required for operator_trigger and wait Cues (the domain rule); optional for project, hold and unavailable.

behavior.description: What the Cue does when taken, discriminated by type.

duration_seconds.description: Per-Cue auto-play override; only inside an item with auto_play_seconds.

reason.description: Why the Cue could not be captured.

path.description: Snapshot-relative, under frames/. The reader also requires every segment to be a legal Windows file name (no device names such as CON or NUL, no trailing dot or space, no reserved characters) and compares paths case-insensitively, so two paths that differ only in ASCII case, across frames and assets together, are one file and are rejected.

Snapshot-relative, under assets/. The reader also requires every segment to be a legal Windows file name (no device names such as CON or NUL, no trailing dot or space, no reserved characters) and compares paths case-insensitively, so two paths that differ only in ASCII case, across frames and assets together, are one file and are rejected.
